confound: The line detector is a Florence-2-family model, so one screened method's own model family controls the input the other is judged on. Accepted and flagged; not neutralized here.

heuristic_catalog.detects: The adapter returned no text at all: a hard failure with a typed cause.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Not necessarily a method defect -- an environment failure (missing venv, OOM, timeout) is recorded here too and is separated by the failure category, never collapsed into 'the method failed'.

heuristic_catalog.detects: Execution succeeded but the returned text is empty or only whitespace.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Not proof the crop is blank. A blank crop *should* produce empty output; this signal cannot distinguish the two without looking at the image, which is a human-review task.

heuristic_catalog.detects: A character or n-gram repetition loop within a single output -- a known VLM/seq2seq decoder degradation mode.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Distinct from `repeated_output_across_inputs`: this is repetition *inside* one output. The two are independent and an output can trip either, both, or neither.

heuristic_catalog.detects: An output of at most `very_short_output_max_length` characters.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Not a defect. Folio numbers and marginal marks are legitimately this short. It is recorded because it marks the input regime where degradation was already observed.

heuristic_catalog.detects: An output whose length is a median/MAD outlier against that same method's own observed length distribution on this run.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Never compared across methods. The two recognizers have different decoders and different length behaviour; pooling their lengths would manufacture outliers that are only differences between methods.

heuristic_catalog.detects: An output at or above the method's configured character ceiling, or a run the adapter itself reported as truncated.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Not confirmed truncation. Without ground truth there is no way to know whether text was lost; this flags the outputs where it is possible.

heuristic_catalog.detects: The same output string returned for two or more *demonstrably different* input crops (different content hashes), aggregated into repeat groups and a distinct-output ratio.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Not an accuracy statement, and not automatically a bug: the SATRN repetition diagnostic established this behaviour as genuine model behaviour on short and distorted crops, not an integration defect. It is a reliability signal about how much the output depends on the input.

heuristic_catalog.detects: A crop whose width/height is below `crop_min_aspect_ratio` -- not line-shaped.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: A segmentation signal, not a recognizer signal. It says the detector produced something that is probably not a text line; it says nothing about what any recognizer then did with it.

heuristic_catalog.detects: Median and p90 wall-clock per method, plus min/max. Descriptive, never a flag.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Not comparable between methods as a quality signal: SATRN restarts a subprocess and reloads its model on every call while Florence-2 caches in-process, so their timings measure different execution models, not different efficiencies.

heuristic_catalog.detects: Peak GPU memory observed per method, where the runtime reported it.
heuristic_catalog.does_not_mean: Descriptive only. No threshold, no flag, and absent where unreported.
